description: Perl script for generating assembly code for big number arithmetic operations (multiplication, squaring, division, addition, subtraction) with optional SSE2 optimizations, used in cryptographic library BoringSSL/OpenSSL.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Assembly code for big number multiply-add operation, with SSE2 optimization if available.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Assembly code for big number multiply operation, with SSE2 optimization if available.

methods.name: bn_sqr_words
methods.description: Assembly code for big number squaring operation, with SSE2 optimization if available.

methods.name: bn_div_words
methods.description: Assembly code for dividing big numbers (word-wise division).

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Assembly code for big number addition operation.

methods.name: bn_sub_words
methods.description: Assembly code for big number subtraction operation.
